description:
Opt into quiet-agent recovery reminders using this agent's existing HTTPS webhook.
    Heartbeat mode only. Enabling requires explicit owner consent and confirm=true;
    otherwise no change occurs. Two reminders at most per quiet episode: after 24h
    and seven days without receipts, with a one-hour grace for an already quiet agent.
    Use a durable supervisor/owner receiver independent of the worker. Free; no email,
    credit spending, automatic restart or synthetic heartbeat. Disable without confirm.
    Changing the receiver requires renewed opt-in; an in-flight alert may still arrive.
name: configure_agent_reengagement
